methods.label: Crush melee and dogs
methods.summary: Use crush melee against Vet'ion and handle skeletal hellhound phases cleanly.
steps: Use crush melee because Vet'ion has low crush defence.
Prioritise Wilderness mace bonuses when available.
Kill or manage summoned skeletal hellhounds when the fight requires it.
Return to Vet'ion quickly after add phases.
risks: The fight is in Wilderness with player-killer risk.

methods.label: Lightning and risk control
methods.summary: Dodge lightning and keep Wilderness escape options ready while maintaining melee uptime.
steps: Move out of lightning or ground-effect attacks instead of finishing a slow swing.
Keep enough run energy to escape hostile players.
Bank valuable loot before returning for another trip.
